after: ротор; несущий винт вертолёта; тормозной диск
why: The gloss names a brake disc as one of the senses and two of the three examples use it ("The mechanic replaced the front rotors", "A bent rotor makes the brakes shudder"). Russian never calls a brake disc a ротор - it is тормозной диск - so the missing sense left those examples untranslatable. The two existing senses were correct and are kept.
